title: Voice assistant
description: Say what you want WorkPilot to do: open a feature, create a task…

input.label: Your command
input.placeholder: Speak, or type a command and press Enter

phase.idle: Press the microphone, or type a command.
phase.downloading: Downloading the speech model (about 150 MB, once)…
phase.listening: Listening… pause when you are done.

confirm.heading: Create this task?
confirm.title: Title
confirm.server: It will be created on the server's board, for the whole team.

results.createFailed: The task could not be created.
results.nothingHeard: I didn't hear anything. Speak again, or type your command.
results.noModel: No AI model answered, so only simple commands are understood right now.
results.noProject: Select a project first: a task belongs to a project.

examples.heading: For example
examples.createTask: “Create a task to add a CSV export”
examples.draw: “Open the feature that lets me draw an architecture”

errors.model: The speech model is not on this computer yet.
errors.dependency: Local speech recognition (faster-whisper) is not installed in the backend.
errors.offline: Strict offline mode blocks the speech model download.
errors.download: The speech model could not be downloaded.
errors.busy: Dictation is already running elsewhere in the app. Finish it, then try again.
errors.timeout: Speech recognition did not answer in time.
errors.transcription: The audio could not be transcribed.
errors.microphone: The microphone is unavailable, or access to it was refused.
errors.downloadNeedsProject: Select a project to download the speech model (its offline policy applies).

settings.title: Voice assistant
settings.description: Open the assistant from anywhere in WorkPilot and tell it what to do.
settings.shortcutHelp: Click Change, then press the new combination. Escape cancels.

conflict.invalid: Use Ctrl, Alt or ⌘ with a letter, a digit, a function key or Space.
conflict.altgr: Ctrl+Alt is AltGr on many keyboards (it types @, € or [). Choose another combination.
conflict.used: {{shortcut}} is already used by WorkPilot or by the system.

settings.systemWide: Even when WorkPilot is in the background
settings.systemWideHelp: Registers the shortcut with the operating system: pressing it brings WorkPilot forward and opens the assistant. Takes effect when you save.
settings.systemWideRefused: The system refused this shortcut (another app may use it, or the desktop does not allow it). It still works inside WorkPilot.
settings.speech: Speech is transcribed on this computer (Whisper). No audio is kept.
settings.model: Simple commands are understood without a model. Other sentences use the “Voice assistant” model of Settings → Agent.
